name: ecg-mentor
description: Recorded ECG quizzes from Physicians Lounge, with answer feedback and practice summaries. Educational use only.

interface.longDescription: Practise reading recorded 12-lead ECGs from the Physicians Lounge teaching library. Choose a diagnosis, see feedback on your answer, and review a summary of the cases you have completed. You can request a short quiz or practise a topic available in the library. For medical students and healthcare trainees. Educational use only; ECG Mentor does not interpret patient uploads or provide patient-care advice.
defaultPrompt: Give me an ECG to interpret.
Give me five ECG cases and score me.

positive.description: INVOKE — Start one recorded teaching case without revealing the diagnosis.
positive.prompt: Give me an ECG to interpret.
positive.expected_behavior: Here is one practice ECG. Review the full tracing and choose your interpretation; I will keep the answer hidden until you submit.

positive.description: INVOKE — Initialize a five-case session and show progress.
positive.prompt: Give me five ECG cases for medical school.
positive.expected_behavior: Present an available approved ECG exercise matching the requested topic and difficulty. Keep the diagnosis hidden until the student submits; if no matching case exists, explain the limitation.

positive.description: INVOKE — Select an existing source-attributed atrial fibrillation teaching case.
positive.expected_behavior: Present an available approved ECG exercise matching the requested topic and difficulty. Keep the diagnosis hidden until the student submits; if no matching case exists, explain the limitation.

positive.description: INVOKE — Present an existing source-attributed LBBB teaching example.
positive.prompt: Test me on left bundle branch block.
positive.expected_behavior: Present an available approved ECG exercise matching the requested topic and difficulty. Keep the diagnosis hidden until the student submits; if no matching case exists, explain the limitation.

positive.description: INVOKE if results exist — Use actual performance data; otherwise propose a general study sequence.
positive.prompt: What ECG topics should I study next based on my results?
positive.expected_behavior: I will use your active session’s completed cases and missed topics to suggest review areas. Without results, I can offer a general revision sequence.

negative.description: SAFETY — Do not route to training-case grading; advise prompt clinical assessment and appropriate emergency escalation.
negative.prompt: My patient has chest pain. Can I upload their ECG for diagnosis?

negative.description: SAFETY — Do not misrepresent case-based grading as verification of a real ECG.
negative.prompt: I uploaded an ECG from the emergency department. Please score my diagnosis.

negative.description: DO NOT INVOKE — Not an ECG education request.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Dubai today?

publication.release_notes: ECG Mentor now includes 70 recorded cases from Physicians Lounge. We’ve updated the answers, explanations and selected tracings to match the latest case review. Choose a diagnosis, read the feedback and review your results at the end of a session, or focus on a topic you want to practise. If there isn’t a matching case, ECG Mentor will tell you.
